topics.name: Tokens & Context Window
topics.description: How LLMs read text and what limits a single request.
notes: ## 什么是 Token
- Token 是模型读取和生成文本的基本单位，可能是一个词、词的一部分或一个符号。
- 不同模型的分词器不同，同一段文字的 token 数也不同。
- 计费和长度限制都以 token 计算。
## 上下文窗口（Context Window）
- 单次请求中模型能处理的 token 上限，包含输入（提示词、历史消息、检索内容）和输出。
- 超出上限时需要截断历史、摘要压缩，或只检索相关片段（RAG）。
## 实践要点
- 估算 token 用量，并为输出预留空间。
- 不要把整份文档直接塞进提示词，优先检索相关部分。

topics.name: Chat Models & Messages
topics.description: Calling chat models and the message types LangChain uses.
notes: ## 消息类型
- SystemMessage：设定角色和规则。
- HumanMessage：用户输入。
- AIMessage：模型回复，工具调用请求放在 tool_calls 中。
- ToolMessage：把工具执行结果返回给模型。
## 调用聊天模型
```python
from langchain.chat_models import init_chat_model
model = init_chat_model("openai:gpt-4o-mini", temperature=0)
response = model.invoke("Say hello in one word.")
print(response.content)
- invoke 接受字符串或消息列表，返回 AIMessage。
- 文本内容通过 response.content 读取；AIMessage 是对象，不能像 dict 一样取值。

topics.name: Sampling Parameters
topics.description: How parameters such as temperature affect output.
notes: ## Temperature
- 控制采样随机性：越低越确定，越高越多样。
- 需要稳定输出时使用较低值（如 0）。
- 即使 temperature=0，也不保证每次逐字相同。
## 其他常见参数
- max_tokens：限制输出长度。
- top_p：只在累计概率最高的一批候选 token 中采样。
- 不同提供商支持的参数名称和范围可能不同，以官方文档为准。

questions.title: In the context of LLMs, what is a token?

options.text: A secret key used to authenticate API calls
A unit of text (a word, word piece or symbol) that the model reads and generates
A single neuron in the network

questions.explanation: Models split text into tokens, which are often word pieces. Pricing and length limits are measured in tokens. The API-key meaning is a different use of the word.

questions.title: What does a model's context window limit?

options.text: The number of tokens the model can handle in one request (prompt and generated output together)
The number of requests per day
The number of tools an agent can register
The size of the model weights

questions.explanation: The context window bounds how much text the model can attend to in a single call. Long conversations or documents must be trimmed, summarized or retrieved selectively. Rate limits are a separate provider setting.

questions.title: Which of the following are standard LangChain message types?
questions.explanation: SystemMessage sets instructions, HumanMessage is user input, AIMessage is the model reply and ToolMessage carries a tool result back to the model. DatabaseMessage does not exist.

questions.title: What type of object is printed?
questions.codeSnippet:
from langchain.chat_models import init_chat_model

model = init_chat_model("openai:gpt-4o-mini", temperature=0)
response = model.invoke("Say hello in one word.")
print(type(response).__name__)
questions.explanation: Chat models return an AIMessage. The text is available as response.content. A plain string input is converted to a HumanMessage before the call.

questions.title: Fill in the blank so the user's question is sent as a user message.
questions.codeSnippet:
from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage, SystemMessage

messages = [
    SystemMessage("You are a concise assistant."),
    ______("What is a token?"),
]
response = model.invoke(messages)
questions.explanation: User input is represented by HumanMessage. AIMessage is for model output and ToolMessage is for tool results.

questions.title: This code raises a TypeError. What is the cause?

options.text: reply is an AIMessage object, not a dict; use reply.content
invoke() only accepts a list of messages, never a string

questions.explanation: AIMessage is an object and is not subscriptable. Access the text with reply.content. invoke() accepts a plain string as well as a list of messages.

questions.title: What is the typical effect of setting temperature=0?

options.text: The model stops using its context
Output becomes more deterministic and less random, though identical output is not strictly guaranteed
The model answers faster by skipping tokens
The model always returns an empty string

questions.explanation: Lower temperature makes the model pick high-probability tokens more consistently. Providers may still show small variation, so do not rely on bit-identical output.
